premises.text: Knowledge is often siloed within enterprises, leading to repeated work and mistakes.
premises.evidence_span: the root cause of this was simply because all the knowledge was siloed.

premises.text: A Q&A platform can help employees find the right person to ask for specific issues.
premises.evidence_span: trying to find who the right person was to ask for trying to solve a specific issue.

premises.text: A collaborative knowledge base can be created by combining Q&A and wiki functionalities.
premises.evidence_span: meld it with the flexibility of wikis to create a really organically growing, really easily searchable knowledge base for the enterprise.

premises.text: Anonymity in questions can encourage employees to ask important but potentially embarrassing questions.
premises.evidence_span: allows for people to ask questions that maybe they thought was a little bit stupid, but really are important.

premises.text: Integrating the platform with email can enhance user engagement and accessibility.
premises.evidence_span: we allow people to ask questions directly by email, answer them directly by replying to an email.

premises.text: The platform can be adapted for various use cases across different industries.
premises.evidence_span: you could use this like a mini internal stack overflow for documenting bugs and solutions.

value.text: Companies can improve knowledge sharing and reduce repeated work through a collaborative platform.
value.evidence_span: help people at companies share knowledge.

notes: Traction metrics and investor names excluded as they do not support premises.
